going_scenario: Soft 5 (assumption, not an official track reading)
headline: Thursday Flemington Oaks Day: nine race-by-race form selections and alternatives
notes: This is a human research-order checkpoint, not the 3 November model card and not a calibrated V5 Top 10.
One selection per race. Ordered by comparative form conviction; ranks are not statistical win chances.
Scratchings and final field positions require a further official check; projected pace is not a certified speed map.
Buccleuch is still published in Thursday R3 after racing Tuesday 3 November; Tavi Time is preferred only as the current Soft 5 form selection.

sources.name: Thursday Flemington scratchings and field preview

selections.form: Five wins and three seconds in eight runs this preparation; two previous Flemington 1000m wins and excellent recent sprint figures.
selections.risk: Straight-course lane bias and possible early speed pressure; final track and scratchings still pending.
selections.pace: Can lead or race close to the lead; monitor where leaders are winning down the straight.

selections.form: Unbeaten in five, including Group 1 Spring Champion Stakes; has handled Good, Soft and Heavy ground.
selections.risk: Barrier 19, first 2500m and stronger staying challengers, especially Wakeful winner De Armas.
selections.pace: Expected to work for position from the wide draw; De Armas can get a much cheaper run from barrier 1.

selections.form: Five wins from ten and four wins at Flemington; class profile is a clear positive.
selections.risk: Five-day turnaround, barrier 12, 59.5kg and only limited proven Soft-track experience.
selections.pace: Can press forward but may work from the outside; Cilacap has the stronger proven Soft record.

selections.form: Recent Rosehill Soft 6 win; two wins from three Soft starts and form around 2000m.
selections.risk: Barrier 13 and a deeper handicap field; recheck final engagement after previous cross-entries.
selections.pace: Needs to avoid covering extra ground; Veyepee has barrier 1.

selections.form: Three wins this campaign, latest a 2.5-length Caulfield win; has won on Soft ground.
selections.risk: Competitive three-year-old sprint with Scintillation a genuine danger.
selections.pace: Scintillation can be prominent from barrier 2; Sequinned draws wider and may need speed to run on.

selections.form: Three wins in five starts, including consecutive latest wins; barrier 2 and 53kg favour the setup.
selections.risk: BM90 rise and no actual Soft-track starts; Heavy-track win is not direct Soft 5 proof.
selections.pace: Can sit handy with a low draw while wide-drawn rivals risk covering ground.

selections.form: Five wins from twelve Soft-track runs, proven mile form, barrier 1 and James McDonald.
selections.risk: Conditional choice while Buccleuch remains listed despite racing on Tuesday 3 November; do not mark Buccleuch as scratched without confirmation.
selections.pace: Likely to receive an economical run on the rail; Just Folk may be more forward.

selections.form: Two consecutive Bendigo wins, including at 1600m on Soft 6; 54.5kg and barrier 5.
selections.risk: Large-field traffic and stronger rivals; not a high-certainty race.
selections.pace: Can settle midfield to handy; Rosa Aotearoa can go forward.

selections.form: Two wins from four Soft starts and a recent 1700m victory.
selections.risk: Class rise into BM70; Bon Fete is an emergency and must be confirmed admitted.
selections.pace: Stung may go forward; Cute Girl can sit midfield and make her run.
